note: Winter's Kiss (the dagger throw): she stands in place in every frame (x and y are 0). Frames 1-5 raise (the frost ring grows and spins up), 6-9 wind-up (the dagger is frozen), 10 the thrown arm extended, the hand open (the old frame 10, the throw pose with the wrong hand, was deleted 2026-11-07; this frame is the release: kissFx throws from the mark of frame hitFrame-1 = 10), 11-12 follow-through (the dagger hits on frame 11 and flies back), 13-14 catch (the dagger arrives in the open hand in frame 14, hitFrame + 3), 15 the idle. 12 fps makes it 1.25 s.
